job.question: In the Shrewsbury Contributory Retirement System RFP for investment consultant services, how long is the chosen consultant expected to be retained?
job.expected_facts: For five (5) years, not to exceed seven (7) years including any renewal, extension or option. The Board can terminate on thirty (30) days written notice.
job.acceptance: Five years and seven-year total ceiling including renewals/extensions/options. Thirty-day termination is optional.

reviews.reason: This is the Anchorage Police and Fire Retirement System RFP, not the Shrewsbury Contributory Retirement System RFP. Its sample contract specifies a three-year period, so it does not support the required five-year term or seven-year ceiling. The matching thirty-day termination provision does not establish the requested term.
quotes: This RFP is issued by the Anchorage Police and Fire Retirement System.
The parties agree that services under this contract shall commence on January 1, 2026, and shall continue until December 31, 2028.
System shall have the right to terminate this Agreement, with or without cause, upon thirty (30) days of written notice to Consultant.
